notes.title: Development Update 4-30-2024
notes.content:
I've been updating the discussion board with a pinned devlog thread, but I figured I would just show rather than tell this time. I've updated the store page with some fresh graphics and a short video that show the current state of the game. Check out the video and let me know what you think.
